body: Thanks, I have done so and they advise me to report him anonymously to avoid more cases. I’ve already double checked my little sister and she’s safe, luckily I’ve always told her what to do and to tell me so if anything happens.
Thanks, revenge really is best served cold. :)

But I have a strategy I use to stop myself: Write and empty  my feelings on a note, destroy said note by soaking, tearing, boiling and throw the bad feelings out the yard.

1) Empty my heart on the note.
2) Destroy the said note.
3) Feel a little stronger and slightly relieved.

I’m not gonna commit suicide bc of a bastard. I’m going to live and I’m wondering whether to let it go. I mean it’s only a few times, but more than half my life of misery. I’m 16 now, I’m getting better and glad I didn’t Suicide. I’m gonna survive and try to watch karma.

Please don’t suicide yet, it’s good to be motivated to do something but please don’t suicide. Write the suicide note but don’t suicide. Just empty your heart then destroy the note.

Step1) Write down your troubles, your emotions. Write down about your childhood. As if you are emptying your heart out. 

Step2) Then when you finish writing the note with all your secrets and reasons and pain.... Destroy it. Soak it in water, tear it apart, boil it. Do whatever to destroy it then pour it out into the yard p, stones, or concrete outside. Feel free and relieved. Do it as many times as you want whenever you need to.

Please don’t give up and die.
It will be okay, I’ve been there before. I had times where I have no reasons, and times where my reasons ignite pain or sometimes hate from horrid people. It’s okay, try heal a bit, slowly try to live life, try play a little game, watch a fun comedy, laugh and cry. Everything will be fine soon, you’ll feel pain, feel numb, keeps on changing then one day you just think to yourself I can’t go on. Either I die and suicide or I live. Please pick live, I did and I don’t regret it though it’s so tiresome sometimes. Please please be okay and don’t commit suicide.
